what: 1. Stack 2D rasters along a new dimension
title: Building multidimensional VRTs from raster collections
text: original job: 2D rasters (COGs, GeoTIFFs) slices one variable, want single 3D array. gdal_mdim_stack() builds new axis scratch. Evenly spaced values detected stored compactly <RegularlySpacedValues> rather long value list; dimension values can pulled file names one-group regex parsed dates; http(s):// sources wrapped /vsicurl/ automatically. convenience wrappers vrt_time_stack(), vrt_depth_stack() vrt_regular_stack() cover common cases shorter calls. source carries <SourceSlab> explicit count, read VRT opens sources covers rather every file.
code: # soil layers by depth gdal_mdim_stack(   files = c("soil_0cm.tif", "soil_30cm.tif", "soil_100cm.tif"),   dim_name = "depth",   dim_values = c(0, 30, 100),   dim_type = "VERTICAL",   dim_direction = "DOWN",   dim_unit = "cm",   output = "soil.vrt" ) # a daily time series, dates parsed from the file names gdal_mdim_stack(   files = list.files(pattern = "temp_\\d{8}\\.tif$"),   dim_name = "time",   dim_values = "(\\d{8})",   parse_format = "%Y%m%d",   dim_type = "TEMPORAL",   time_origin = "1970-01-01",   time_unit = "days",   output = "temperature.vrt" )

title: Building multidimensional VRTs from raster collections
text: sources already multidimensional (NetCDF, Zarr, HDF5) may hold several arrays . , fastest route take small “first files” VRT recipe flesh full file set, re-writing concat dimension per-array source lists. Everything else - coordinate arrays, slab geometry, per-array scale/offset/unit/attributes - carried verbatim. concat dimension need first axis, named "time": axis position read recipe. ready-made recipe can passed instead TRUE (path XML string). metadata_from chooses source donates coordinate units root-group provenance restored onto auto-generated recipe ("first", "last", explicit path) - repair metadata gdal mdim mosaic drops. graft_coord_units() graft_group_attrs() expose repair directly -ops metadata already present.
code: # `template = TRUE` auto-generates the recipe from the first n files via # `gdal mdim mosaic`, then extends it to the whole set. vrtstack(   files = all_files,              # e.g. thousands of daily NetCDFs   concat = "(\\d{8})", parse_format = "%Y%m%d",   origin = "1978-01-01", unit = "days",   template = TRUE, concat_dim = "time",   output = "series.vrt" )

what: 3. Emit a VRT from a catalog signature
title: Building multidimensional VRTs from raster collections
text: grid known catalog (STAC, CMR, URL template) rather opening file, emitter path builds VRT two plain structures never touches data: sources table (one row per step) signature (grid array metadata collection). contract “identical grid refuse”: emitter trusts signature, collection whose assets grid refusal, never resample. stac_sufficiency() reports whether parsed STAC item carries fields signature needs, verify_vrt() round-trips emitted VRT gdal mdim info.
code: src <- mdim_sources(   time = as.Date(c("2024-01-01", "2024-01-02")),   dsn = c("/vsicurl/.../20240101.tif", "/vsicurl/.../20240102.tif"),   source_ref = "1", kind = "band",          # a COG band; use "array" for NetCDF   source_view = "[newaxis,...]"             # rank a 2D band up to the 3D cube )  sig <- mdim_signature(   collection = "demo", variable = "sst",   nx = 1440, ny = 720,   x0 = 0.125, dx = 0.25, y0 = 89.875, dy = -0.25,   srs = "EPSG:4326", dtype = "Int16",   nodata = -999, scale = 0.01, unit = "Celsius" )  emit_mdim_vrt(src, sig, "demo.vrt")

title: Create GDAL Multidimensional VRTs from 2D Raster Collections
text: gdal_mdim_stack() builds new dimension 2D rasters. Two paths cover sources already multidimensional, sources described catalog: Extend recipe (vrtstack(..., template = TRUE)): NetCDF/Zarr/HDF5 sources may carry several arrays , take small “first-n” mdim VRT recipe flesh full file set, re-writing concat dimension per-array source lists. metadata_from graft_coord_units() / graft_group_attrs() helpers restore coordinate units provenance gdal mdim mosaic drops. Emit signature (emit_mdim_vrt()): grid known catalog, build VRT sources table (mdim_sources()) grid signature (mdim_signature()) without opening file - “identical grid refuse”. stac_sufficiency() checks STAC item carries needed fields; verify_vrt() round-trips result gdal mdim info. gdal_run()-backed paths (verify_vrt(), template = TRUE recipe generation, metadata grafts) need GDAL >= 3.11.3; pure-XML builders work GDAL. See vignette("vrtstack") walk three.

text: files Character vector file paths (COGs, GeoTIFFs, /vsicurl/ URIs, etc.) dim_name Name new dimension (e.g., "time", "depth", "level") dim_values Dimension values. One : Numeric vector values (length must match files) regex pattern one capturing group extract filenames function taking filename (basename) returning numeric value NULL using dim_start + dim_increment dim_start, dim_increment regular axes, specify start increment instead explicit values. Files assumed correct order. dim_type Optional dimension type: "TEMPORAL", "VERTICAL", "PARAMETRIC" dim_direction Optional direction: "NORTH", "SOUTH", "EAST", "WEST", "", "", "FUTURE", "PAST" dim_unit Unit string dimension (e.g., "days since 1970-01-01", "cm") time_origin temporal dimensions, origin date "YYYY-MM-DD" POSIXct. set parse_format, values encoded offsets origin. time_unit temporal dimensions: "seconds", "minutes", "hours", "days" parse_format date/time extraction, strptime() format string (e.g., "%Y%m%d" "20230115") array_name Name data array VRT. Default: derived common filename prefix, "data". output Output VRT path. NULL, returns XML string without writing.

title: Create a Multidimensional VRT from 2D Rasters — gdal_mdim_stack
text: function generates GDAL Multidimensional VRT virtually stacks 2D rasters along new dimension. Key features: Regular axes: dimension values evenly spaced (specified via dim_start/dim_increment), VRT uses <RegularlySpacedValues> compact representation. Auto-detection: Even explicit dim_values, regular spacing detected automatically converted compact form. Filename parsing: Extract dimension values filenames using regex, optional date/time parsing. Useful time series like "temperature_20230101.tif". Cloud-native: Supports /vsicurl/ URIs remote files. HTTP(S) URLs automatically prefixed /vsicurl/. resulting VRT can read : GDAL's multidim API: gdalmdiminfo, gdalmdimtranslate Python xarray backends: gdx, xgdal tool supporting GDAL multidimensional rasters

title: Stack rasters into a multidimensional VRT (two paths, one entry point) — vrtstack
text: -scratch (template = NULL) - original GeoTIFF/COG path. 2D source contributes one slab single new 3D array. Sources use classic <SourceBand> + <SourceTranspose> form. template-extend (template = <vrt> template = TRUE) - mdim-recognised sources (NetCDF/Zarr/HDF5) may carry several arrays (OISST: anom/err/ice/sst). small "first-n" mdim VRT taken recipe, full file set fleshed re-parameterising concat dimension per-array <Source> lists. Everything else (coordinate arrays, slab geometry, scale/offset/unit/attributes) carried verbatim template. template GDAL-native analogue "recipe--payload" principle: GDAL's gdal mdim mosaic writes recipe first n files; template axis varies file set.

title: vrtstack (development version)
text: New vignette vignette("vrtstack") walking three entry points (-scratch stacking, recipe extension, catalog emitter), pkgdown site grouped reference index, README section covering three. GDAL >= 3.11.3 requirement gdal_run()-backed paths documented.

title: vrtstack (development version)
text: gdal_mdim_stack() (vrt_*_stack() wrappers) now copy source band’s scale, offset unit type onto data array. Packed bands GHRSST MUR analysed_sst (Int16, scale 0.001, offset 25) previously read back raw counts VRT’s unscaled view. <SRS> dataAxisToSRSAxisMapping now computed CRS’s WKT axis order instead fixed "2,1". (stack, y, x) array EPSG:4326 (latitude first) "2,3"; old value mapped longitude onto stack dimension, 2D slice array got invalid mapping. emit_mdim_vrt(), wrote mapping (GDAL assumes "1,2"), gets computed mapping. Array children written XSD’s order: stack coordinate’s <Unit> values, emit_mdim_vrt()’s Unit / NoDataValue / Offset / Scale.

title: vrtstack (development version)
text: New catalog--VRT emitter surface, revived earlier design work: mdim_sources() table (one row per concat step, kind = "band" "array") per-collection mdim_signature() (grid, SRS, dtype, array metadata) fed emit_mdim_vrt(), writes multidimensional VRT without opening file – grid comes signature (“identical grid refuse”, warping). stac_sufficiency() reports whether parsed STAC item carries metadata emitter needs, verify_vrt() round-trips emitted VRT gdal mdim info. Design notes inst/design/mdim-vrt-catalog-scoping.md. vrtstack() gains metadata_from ("first", "last", explicit source path) choose source donates coordinate units root-group provenance restored onto auto-generated recipe (template = TRUE). concat dimension may axis, axis 0, need named "time": mdim_template_extend() takes axis position DimensionRef order. regularly-spaced concat coordinate converted explicit inline values concat_values supplied.

title: vrtstack (development version)
text: mdim_template_extend() now gives clear error concat dimension coordinate array name, instead opaque xml node-type error, validates inline-vs-regular coordinate values robustly.

title: vrtstack 0.2.0
text: gdal_mdim_stack() longer derives data-array name bare common filename prefix, produce numeric, invalid array name (e.g. 200206 shared date). resolver now takes variable token shared part names – first identifier word common prefix last common suffix, whichever carries letters (e.g. analysed_sst GHRSST tiles, claytotal soil layers) – never leading-digit name, falls back band1. explicit array_name still overrides. Band-description-based naming left later option. (#1) gdal_mdim_stack() now writes <SourceSlab offset="0,0,0" count="1,nrow,ncol" step="1,1,1"/> every source. Without count, GDAL opens every source, order, learn shape read VRT (HEAD header GET per /vsicurl/ COG), even one-step read long remote stack touched every file. , read opens sources covers. finding mdsumner/raad.virtualize#14; see also hypertidy/gdalxarray#39, stops sparse selections widened covering read. template-extend path vrtstack() already copied count template. Tests added (tests/testthat/test-sourceslab.R).

title: vrtstack 0.2.0
text: New graft_coord_units() graft_group_attrs() restore metadata gdal mdim mosaic drops recipe: coordinate-array units (CF units, netCDF driver lifts array Unit rather attribute) invariant root-group provenance attributes (title, source, references). idempotent read values one source via gdal mdim info, supplied units=/attrs= vector needs GDAL. wired template = TRUE path vrtstack() via internal mdim_recipe_xml(), become -ops GDAL propagates metadata . New vrtstack() single entry point two construction paths share one concat-axis resolver: -scratch (template = NULL) - existing GeoTIFF/COG behaviour, stacking 2D sources single new 3D array. template-extend (template = <vrt> template = TRUE) - fleshes small “first-n” multidimensional VRT full file set, re-parameterising concat dimension per-array <Source> lists. Coordinate arrays, slab geometry, per-array scale/offset/unit/attributes carried verbatim template. New mdim_template_extend() performs recipe rewrite pure xml2 tree operation (GDAL required). handles sources carry several arrays (e.g. OISST anom/err/ice/sst): data arrays detected structurally <Array> owning <Source>, array’s SourceArray path slab count/step read first source rather assumed array name. concat axis position taken DimensionRef order, need axis 0. New resolve_concat() turns concat-axis spec (explicit vector, single-group regex basenames, function basename, date-parsing inputs) axis values, shared construction paths. New mdim_mosaic_xml() builds first-n recipe via gdal mdim mosaic /vsimem/, template file need touch disk (requires gdalraster gdal_run algorithm interface).

title: vrtstack 0.2.0
text: Filename extraction now uses stringr::str_match() instead regmatches()/regexec(), silently dropped non-matches misaligned rows files. VRT construction editing now go xml2 rather string assembly, removing hand-rolled XML escaping. mdim_template_extend() rejects Date/POSIXct concat_values clear message: coordinate values must already array’s declared units (e.g. days-since-epoch). Encode first via resolve_concat(origin=, unit=) read source files.

title: vrtstack 0.2.0
text: Declared xml2, stringr, jsonlite utils Imports (used undeclared, R CMD check error). Added continuous integration: standard R-CMD-check matrix, canary job checks development GDAL build (hypertidy gdal-r-python:dev), changes GDAL’s multidim surface caught early.

title: vrtstack 0.2.0
